title: Dynamic Test Design
abstract: arXiv:2610.31817v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study dynamic test design under the threat of manipulation. At each instant, a principal who cannot commit to future actions chooses whether to hire an agent, fire him, or continue costly probation by designing a test. The test provides information about the agent's persistent type, which is either good or bad. After observing the test choice, the bad type can exert costly effort to manipulate the evidence and mimic the good type. Deterring manipulation imposes an endogenous information budget that limits how intensively the principal can test. We show that, except at beliefs that remain unchanged in the absence of news, equilibrium tests are one-sided: they generate only passes, which trigger hiring, or only failures, which trigger firing. translated_abstract: 我们研究在操纵威胁下的动态测试设计问题。在每一时刻，一个无法对未来行动作出承诺的委托人选择是雇佣代理人、解雇代理人，还是通过设计测试继续成本高昂的试用期。测试提供关于代理人持久类型的信息，其类型要么为好要么为坏。在观察到测试选择后，坏类型代理人可以付出成本高昂的努力来操纵证据并模仿好类型。阻止操纵会施加一个内生的信息预算，限制了委托人测试的强度。我们证明，除了在缺乏新消息时信念保持不变的那些信念点之外，均衡测试是单边的：它们要么只产生通过（触发雇佣），要么只产生失败（触发解雇）。均衡结果表现为：要么在付出高昂的延迟成本后作出正确的雇佣和解雇决策，要么立即作出但存在资源错配风险的决策。在委托人能够作出承诺的情形下，委托人则会将测试维持在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文研究在坏类型代理人可操纵证据的威胁下的动态测试设计问题，证明在委托人缺乏承诺能力时，均衡测试是单边的（只产生通过或只产生失败），均衡结果要么是付出延迟成本后的正确决策，要么是立即作出但有错配风险的决策。
en_tdlr: This paper studies dynamic test design under the threat of evidence manipulation, showing that when the principal cannot commit, equilibrium tests are one-sided—generating only passes (triggering hiring) or only failures (triggering firing)—yielding either correct decisions after costly delay or immediate decisions that risk misallocation.
